steps.1: Squeeze the front brake once and watch both pads land on the rim.
steps.2: Turn the bike over, flip the lever open, and lift the frame so the wheel drops out.
steps.3: Hold the lever still and unscrew the nut off the end of the skewer.
steps.4: Slide the skewer out. Each spring points its narrow end toward the hub.
steps.5: Hold the wheel up and give it a spin. Look along the tread and the spokes.
steps.6: Set the wheel back between the fork blades, axle at the top of both slots.
steps.7: Run your fingers round the flat metal band the pads touch, all the way round.
steps.8: Check that each brake pad lines up with the rim, not the tire.
steps.9: Slide the skewer back through the hub, lever on the left, and thread the nut on.
steps.10: Snug the nut, then fold the lever flat along the fork, pointing up.
steps.11: Turn the bike upright. Spin the wheel and squeeze the brake.
